title: Bishkek City Hall protest opposing proposed minibus fare increase
reason: Provisional under-threshold exclusion: the opened 24.kg report describes “several people” with banners, with no 50-person evidence.
notes: The demand targeted domestic city fare policy. No exact headcount was reported. Do not add absent minibuses or driver numbers to participant count. S011 is search-only and S016 is a retrospective selection; keep the case revisable if a source establishes 50+.

title: Bishkek minibus drivers’ fare-related work stoppage
reason: Excluded provisionally because the opened report documents a work stoppage/service withdrawal, not a public gathering of 50 or more people.
notes: Municipal fare policy is implicated, but the number of minibuses/vehicles not operating and the number of drivers refusing work are not counts of people assembled. The report does not document a march, rally or a 50-person public gathering. Search for evidence of a separate public assembly before review.
